paper.title: Sparsity for Gradient-Based Optimization of Wind Farm Layouts
paper.authors: Benjamin T. Varela and Andrew Ning

public_source.target_source_status: no paper-specific optimization repository or target-era sparsity script located
public_source.authority_use: same-author equation and data lineage only; not target program

paper_problem.start_perturbation: each x and y coordinate independently plus or minus 2 rotor diameters
paper_problem.paired_comparison: dense and sparse gradients use every common start

paper_method.jacobian_shape: N turbine-energy outputs by 2N layout inputs for each wind state
paper_method.compression: threshold pattern, conflict graph column coloring, compressed forward automatic differentiation
paper_method.global_threshold_trigger: pattern updates reach five sixths of wind-state count; 10 for 12 states
paper_method.state_pattern_trigger: 10 percent of retained calculated values at least two orders below current threshold

missing_information: target repository, source revision, package versions and executable scripts
optimizer name and all optimizer, tolerance, line-search and stopping settings
turbine model revision, rotor quadrature and local-turbulence options
exact random seeds, starts, final layouts, convergence traces and numeric figure arrays
numerical minimum-spacing constraint described only as sufficient space
exact accuracy-sweep thresholds and every plotted coordinate
paper_source_conflicts: The paper states maximum ring population with at least 5.1D spacing, but its exact farm-size sequence and the public 38-turbine fixture imply floor(6.4k) ring counts and approximately 5D outer-ring chord spacing, below 5.1D.
FLOWFarm's public sparsity implementation postdates the target paper and has continued to change; it cannot be labelled the target implementation.
completion_decisions: Preserve the paper's exact 38-to-349 turbine sequence and the public round-layout lineage, calculate and expose actual initial spacing, and retain the stated 5.1kD radii.
Implement source-lineage Cumulative Curl equations, zero yaw, no local-TI correction, hub-height evaluation and the public NREL-5MW Cp/Ct values needed at up to 8 m/s.
Use projected gradient ascent with deterministic Armijo backtracking, circular projection and a disclosed 2D spacing repair because the target optimizer and numeric spacing are absent.
Use the 2D spacing completion from FLOWFarm's documented optimization example, not as a target-paper claim.
Use target adaptive threshold and pattern-update rules and deterministic greedy column coloring.
Run accuracy at thresholds 1e-8, 1e-10, 1e-12, 1e-14 and 1e-16 for all eight paper sizes because exact plotted thresholds are unavailable.
Run all 10 common starts with dense and sparse variants; do not require target numerical or timing replay.

parallel_axes: independent color blocks within each wind-state Jacobian
persistent all-core execution across every wind state and optimization iteration
deterministic indexed Jacobian writes and ordered AEP-gradient reductions
hpc_contract.same_evaluator_rule: dense and sparse paths share evaluator, dual arithmetic, optimizer, starts, constraints and work accounting; only seed compression differs
hpc_contract.h6: one-worker versus all-Waffle-core scaling plus dense-versus-sparse repeated-kernel comparison on the 349-turbine single-direction problem

claim_boundary: Flexible equation-, algorithm- and protocol-level academic reproduction of the target sparse-colored gradient method and paper-native round-farm problems using disclosed same-author FLOWFarm lineage. It is not the author target source, exact FLOWFarm revision, ForwardDiff or SparseDiffTools execution, optimizer, random stream, layout, numerical figure or timing replay.
